text:
Maya: :rotating_light: Heads up — discovered an RBAC policy bug that can allow cross-org project access for some 'project-viewer' grants. Repro & query below.

Darren: repro steps? is this in prod or staging?

Maya: repro in prod. Steps: 1) user A in org X gets a 'project-viewer' grant on project P belonging to org Y. 2) API /projects/:id returns metadata for P even though user_org != resource_org.

Maya: faulty policy snippet (rego-ish):
```
# policy: allow if role matches, but missing org equality check
allow {
  input.user.roles[_] == "project-viewer"
  input.resource.type == "project"
  # MISSING CHECK: input.user.org_id == input.resource.org_id
}
```

Irene: yikes. Any idea how many accounts are affected?

Maya: initial audit shows ~17 distinct user_ids in prod over the last 7 days that hit cross-org project endpoints. No obvious data exfil (no S3 downloads seen), but resource names + config visible.

Nate: KMS question — are we sure no decryption happened via CMKs? which keys back these projects?

Maya: checked key-usage logs (KMS). No decrypt calls mapping to those user_ids in the window. Looks limited to metadata read.

Yana: tagging this P2 for now until we confirm scope. Proposed mitigations: 1) emergency policy roll (deny cross-org project reads for non-admins), 2) revoke offending grants, 3) add alert for cross_org_access events, 4) schedule postmortem + compliance notification.

Darren: I'll open a PR to add the org_id equality check and add unit + integration tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4387 (draft). Owner: @Darren.

Maya: SQL to enumerate potentially impacted grants: 
```sql
SELECT id, user_id, user_org, resource_id, resource_org, role, granted_at
FROM rbac_grants
WHERE role = 'project-viewer'
  AND resource_type = 'project'
  AND user_org IS NOT NULL
  AND user_org <> resource_org;
```

Maya: running a dry-run revoke script now: `./scripts/revoke_cross_org_grants.py --dry-run --since 2024-04-08`

ops-bot: Job queued: revoke_cross_org_grants (dry-run). job_id=9123

ops-bot: Dry-run complete. 24 grants flagged, 0 revoked.

Irene: I'll kick an emergency policy patch to prod in canary first. Deploy bot will post status.

deploy-bot: Policy rollout started by Irene at 2024-04-15T14:12:00Z — canary to 5% then ramp.

deploy-bot: Canary OK. Rolling to 100% at 2024-04-15T14:22:00Z.

ops-bot: Revoke job (non-dry) queued: job_id=9131 — will revoke 24 grants after validation. ETA ~10m.

Nate: After rollback/patch, let's capture a full audit bundle (events + KMS logs) for SOC. Irene, can you own compliance packet?

Irene: yes, on it. Will attach logs and timeline to the ticket and notify compliance + legal.

Maya: created sec-ticket S-2024-042: cross-org-rbac-elevation, severity=P2, owners: Darren (fix), Irene (compliance), Yana (ops remediation).

Darren: PR updated with tests. Also added a lint rule to prevent policy blocks without org equality checks for project resources.

Yana: post-fix actions: run full scan, add alert metric (cross_org_access.count), and add a weekly job to verify grants have matching orgs.

Maya: note for future: policy review checklist — ensure every resource check includes org boundary check unless explicitly global.

Nate: thanks team. Good catch. Keep thread updated once revoke job finishes and compliance packet is submitted. :thumbsup:
